spec.name: sprint39_taker_imbalance_spy_v1
spec.hypothesis: Short-window taker buy/sell volume imbalance on SPY 1-min bars predicts short-horizon continuation in the imbalance direction, net of costs.
spec.power_argument: Threshold calibrated to ~15-20 fires/trading day; ~20-day sealed window yields ~300-400 entries, powered (alpha=0.05, power~0.8) to detect >=3bps/trade net edge given ~5-7bps/min SPY intraday return stdev.
